# SoneVibe

SoneVibe is a Uniswap V2-style constant-product DEX. The main chain is BNB Chain (chain ID 56). Each swap pays a flat 0.25% fee (9975/10000), taken from the input and left in the pool. Liquidity providers earn 5/6 of that fee. The protocol treasury receives 1/6. Yields and APR are variable, not guaranteed. The factory init code hash is 0x87b780b5d19df9ad0d4c866dcd6b169f14846fb24232a128b678c5bdb395b012. A flash swap calls vibeCall, not uniswapV2Call.

Arbitrum One (chain ID 42161) also runs the DEX. Astar (592) and Polkadot Hub (420420419) were retired on Nov 23, 2026.

The init code hash is the same on BNB Chain and Arbitrum.

BNB Chain (chain ID 56), the main chain:
Public RPC: https://bsc-dataseed.binance.org
Block explorer: https://bscscan.com
- Router: 0xa393E76bE079cF1ccf684D0f815795Dde248f157
- Factory: 0x26b13e7e923e964b0514B3167A90901B49DAe205
- WBNB: 0xbb4CdB9CBd36B01bD1cBaEBF2De08d9173bc095c
- ETH (BSC-peg ETH): 0x2170Ed0880ac9A755fd29B2688956BD959F933F8
- USDT: 0x55d398326f99059fF775485246999027B3197955
- ETH/USDT pair (featured): 0x93016Fa6e3c184c96Df7466579DfaA970C7cb6A5
  factory.getPair(ETH, USDT) returns this pair. token0 is ETH. token1 is USDT.
- USDT/WBNB pair (listed, not featured): 0x6dABcbFdFE097e421269a444eBF22999B1EAE279
  factory.getPair(USDT, WBNB) returns this pair. token0 is USDT. token1 is WBNB.
Factory init code hash: 0x87b780b5d19df9ad0d4c866dcd6b169f14846fb24232a128b678c5bdb395b012
The factory bytecode is identical to the Arbitrum factory.
This router address is the live router on BNB Chain. Always match address and chain ID.
Deprecated on BNB (bsc-deprecated, do not use): factory 0xaf905e66038EcE89e03D843B35a11D262053B630, router 0x7532b23DFB30ac22b2a74E3B81cC288de19379BA.

Farm pools, LP tokens, and token addresses are in the machine-readable index:
https://sonevibe.github.io/Lending/agents.json

Arbitrum One (chain ID 42161):
Public RPC: https://arb1.arbitrum.io/rpc
Fallback RPC: https://arbitrum-one.publicnode.com
Block explorer: https://arbiscan.io
- Router: 0x8BE6469287A872B34665F5c0c8fbce73c0Dcbf72
- Factory: 0xA95107ebE4e54480bA755061eF3207c3421150f0
- WETH: 0x82aF49447D8a07e3bd95BD0d56f35241523fBab1
- USDC: 0xaf88d065e77c8cC2239327C5EDb3A432268e5831
- WETH/USDC pair: 0x4DF5bcAC28b8898988Ba576B8463664b53ddb9F7
  factory.getPair(WETH, USDC) returns this pair. token0 is WETH. token1 is USDC.
Swap fee: 0.25% (9975/10000).
Factory init code hash: 0x87b780b5d19df9ad0d4c866dcd6b169f14846fb24232a128b678c5bdb395b012
Sourcify exact match. The factory fund-rescue function is removed. The router still has owner-only rescueFunds(address), which can move only ETH or ERC-20 already held by the router and cannot access pair liquidity.

Minimal ABIs (Router, Pair, Factory, ERC20):
https://sonevibe.github.io/Lending/abi/router.json
https://sonevibe.github.io/Lending/abi/pair.json
https://sonevibe.github.io/Lending/abi/factory.json
https://sonevibe.github.io/Lending/abi/erc20.json

A read-only quote and a swap transaction with amountOutMin and a deadline:
https://sonevibe.github.io/Lending/examples/swap-viem.md
Add and remove liquidity, with amountAMin, amountBMin, and a deadline:
https://sonevibe.github.io/Lending/examples/add-liquidity-viem.md
The user's own wallet signs. Private keys never belong in code.

Live DEX pairs are in the machine-readable pools feed:
https://sonevibe.github.io/Lending/pools.json

The README separates Sourcify-verified deployed sources from reference copies and legacy contracts:
https://github.com/SoneVibe/Lending/tree/main/contracts
https://github.com/SoneVibe/Lending/blob/main/contracts/README.md
